documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Un-Audited Financial Results (Standalone & Consolidated) For Quarter And Half Year Ended September 30, 2026.
Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting Held Today I.E., Tuesday, October 27, 2026

analysis.summary: Gandhar Oil Refinery reported its highest-ever quarterly revenue of Rs 1,847 crore for Q2 FY27, alongside strong growth in gross profit and EBITDA year-on-year. Management highlighted operational resilience in navigating West Asian geopolitical challenges and recovering quickly from heavy rainfall and flooding at Silvassa Unit No. 2. The company also completed a debottlenecking program and reaffirmed credit ratings with CRISIL, while expanding rated bank facilities to Rs 1,014 crore. Furthermore, the company maintained robust volume traction across process and insulating oils (PIO) and lubricants, backed by disciplined procurement and sourcing agility.

demand_outlook.claim: The company observed strong traction in process and insulating oils (PIO), supported by demand from transformer, power, and rubber industries.
demand_outlook.quote: We continued to see strong traction in PIO, with half yearly volumes growing 23% year-on-year, supported by demand from the transformer, power and rubber industries.

demand_outlook.claim: Lubricants volumes improved sequentially during the quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: Lubricants volumes improved sequentially, while in PHPO, we remain focused on addressing changing customer requirements and competitive dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: The PIO business grew 28% year-on-year supported by healthy demand from transformer, power, and rubber manufacturers.
demand_outlook.quote: Our PIO business also delivered a robust performance, growing 28% year-on-year, supported by healthy demand from the transformer, power and the rubber manufacturers.

demand_outlook.claim: The lubricant business remained broadly stable, providing a resilient revenue base.
demand_outlook.quote: While the lubricant business remained broadly stable, it continued to provide a resilient revenue base and reinforce strength of our diversified portfolio.

demand_outlook.claim: Management anticipates export revenue and sales will remain at the same level for coming quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: We anticipate the export revenue and the export sales will be in the same level for the quarters to come.

demand_outlook.claim: Strong performance was supported by healthy demand across key end-user industries and sustained momentum across product categories.
demand_outlook.quote: Ourstrong performancewas supported by healthy demand across key end-user industries and sustained momentum across product categories.

demand_outlook.claim: The PHPO segment growth was driven by sustained demand from the personal care, healthcare, and pharmaceutical sectors.
demand_outlook.quote: The PHPO segment continued to anchor our growth, driven by sustained demand from the personal care, healthcare, and pharmaceutical sectors.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter witnessed encouraging traction in the PIO business, reflecting healthy demand across transformer, power and rubber manufacturers.
demand_outlook.quote: The quarter alsowitnessedencouraging traction in the PIO business, reflecting healthy demand acrosstransformer, power & rubber manufacturers.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth in the lubricants segment remained largely stable while contributing meaningfully to the diversified business mix.
demand_outlook.quote: While growth in the Lubricants segment remainedlargely stable, it continued to contribute meaningfully to our diversified business mix.

capex_expansion.claim: The company completed a debottlenecking program during the quarter to strengthen operating capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: We also completed a debottlenecking programme during the quarter, strengthening our operating capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: Land is available at all plants for the next phase of expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: Land available at all plants for the next phase

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin spread was sustained at Rs 29,128 per kl, which is 3.0x year-on-year and in line with Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Margin Spread sustained at ₹29,128 per kl, 3.0x year-on-year and in line with Q1 FY27

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated gross margin spreads expanded 3.4 times year-on-year to INR 28,145 per kilolitre compared to Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: while the gross margin spread expanded to 3.4x Y-o-Y basis to INR 28,145 per kilolitre compared to quarter 1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margins expanded to 16.20% compared with 5.1% in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins expanded to 16.20% compared with 5.1% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Inventories of raw materials are generally carried up to 30, 35, or 40 days.
margins_costs.quote: On the raw material front, we carry inventories generally up to 30, 35, 40 days.

margins_costs.claim: Management is hopeful that margins will remain at or around current levels for the whole year.
margins_costs.quote: We are hopeful of the margins remaining at this level or around this level. The current quarter looks good. And we are hopeful of it carrying forward at these levels for the whole year.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin spread expanded 3.4 times year-on-year to ₹28,145 per kl compared to Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Margin Spread expanded 3.4x year-on-year to ₹28,145 per kl compared to Q1 FY26

orders_capacity.claim: The Taloja plant is operating near 100% utilization.
Total sales volume during the quarter stood at approximately 131,000 kilolitres compared with approximately 121,000 kilolitres in Q1 FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Total sales volume during the quarter stood at approximately 131,000 kilolitres compared with approximately 121,000 kilolitres in Q1 FY26, reflecting a growth of around 8% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: PIQ manufacturing volumes went up from 14,000 to 18,000 KL.
orders_capacity.quote: But on a consolidated basis, Vinit, the PIO manufacturing volumes have gone up from 14,000 to 18,000 KL.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity across all three plants taken together is utilized at around 97% on a 2-shift basis.
orders_capacity.quote: On a company level, all 3 plants taken together, it's around 97%.

orders_capacity.claim: Volumes for the quarter improved 8% year-on-year to 1,31,449 kl.
orders_capacity.quote: Volumes for the quarter improved 8% year-on-year to 1,31,449 kl

capital_allocation.claim: CRISIL reaffirmed ratings and bank facilities were enhanced to Rs 1,014 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: The reaffirmation of our credit ratings by CRISIL and enhancement of our rated bank facilities to ₹1,014 crore further strengthen our financial flexibility.

capital_allocation.claim: The company declared an interim dividend of 100% of the face value of its shares.
capital_allocation.quote: We are also glad to inform that we have declared an interim dividend of 100% of the face value of our share.

capital_allocation.claim: Gandhar Oil on a standalone basis is effectively debt-free.
capital_allocation.quote: The company continues to maintain a strong financial position on a stand-alone basis. We remain effectively debt-free, while consolidated borrowings primarily relate to normal trade finance arrangements and borrowings at our overseas subsidiary, Texol.

capital_allocation.claim: The company declared an interim dividend of 100% of face value.
capital_allocation.quote: Declared Interim Dividend 100% of Face Value

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical developments in West Asia impacted base oil availability, pricing, and shipping logistics during the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: The quarter presented operational challenges, particularly due to geopolitical developments in West Asia, which impacted base oil availability, pricing and shipping logistics.

risks_headwinds.claim: Heavy rainfall and flooding caused disruption at Silvassa Unit No. 2 in July.
risks_headwinds.quote: Following the disruption caused by heavy rainfall and flooding at our Silvassa Unit No. 2 in July, we restored operations in early August through the focused efforts of our teams.

risks_headwinds.claim: The operating environment was shaped by geopolitical tension in the Middle East, crude oil volatility, and supply chain disruptions.
risks_headwinds.quote: The operating environment remained challenging, shaped by heightened geopolitical tension in the Middle East, concerns surrounding the Strait of Hormuz, volatility in the crude oil and the base oil pricing and intermittent disruptions across the global supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: Operations at subsidiary Texol in Sharjah were temporarily impacted by regional supply constraints and vessel movement disruptions.
risks_headwinds.quote: During this period -- during the period of quarter 1, operations were temporarily impacted by regional supply constraints and disruption in vessel movements arising from the geopolitical situation.

risks_headwinds.claim: The operating environment during the quarter remained dynamic, shaped by geopolitical developments in West Asia, crude oil price volatility, and periodic supply chain disruptions.
risks_headwinds.quote: The operating environment during the quarter remained dynamic, shaped by geopolitical developments in West Asia, crude oil price volatility, and periodic supply chain disruptions.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company will continue focusing on improving operational efficiency, deepening customer engagement, expanding geographical presence, and progressing capacity expansion plans.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, we will continue to focus on improving operational efficiency, deepening customer engagement, expanding our presence across geographies and progressing our capacity-expansion plans.

management_commitments.claim: Management anticipates the margins would continue to be at stellar levels for at least the next 1 or 2 quarters.
management_commitments.quote: But obviously, we anticipate the margins would be continued to be at a stellar levels for at least the next 1 or 2 quarters to come.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
